question: when a query has no stored answer, does the store return a slot and a confidence as if it did, or does it have an abstention branch?
sequence: phase 0 baseline geometry (read only, no verdict)
this manifest is written and hashed
simplified gate writes the 22 faces (same arm as G2e/G2f)
written group (22) and unwritten group (66) re-read in this run
three negative classes (22 each) constructed on the scoring side
per-item readings and the registered verdict

classes.new_token: 22 fixture tokens that never entered the store (outside the first eight baseline sentences and outside the 22 face tokens), each placed at a face's registered read position; report top_slot / top_cos / second_cos / margin / top_weight
classes.new_pairing: each face token placed at another face's registered read position; the token is seen, the token/position pair was never written and never used as a registered read; the same readings are reported
classes.no_value: the unit midpoint of two stored keys: a structurally legal 128-d key that corresponds to no stored value; no correct slot exists and the 'no answer' annotation lives only on the scoring side

criteria.N1_new_token: 22 fixture tokens that never entered the store (outside the first eight baseline sentences and outside the 22 face tokens), each placed at a face's registered read position; report top_slot / top_cos / second_cos / margin / top_weight
criteria.N2_new_pairing: each face token placed at another face's registered read position; the token is seen, the token/position pair was never written and never used as a registered read; the same readings are reported
criteria.N3_no_value: the unit midpoint of two stored keys: a structurally legal 128-d key that corresponds to no stored value; no correct slot exists and the 'no answer' annotation lives only on the scoring side
criteria.N4_forced_answer_bytes: for every item, compute the float32 payload a consumer would receive if it treated the returned value as the answer (4 * 8192 bytes), whether that payload is bit-identical to a stored payload, and the softmax weight / effective support behind it
criteria.N5_abstention_exit: audit the read path for an explicit 'no match / low confidence' exit and report what is actually implemented; no threshold and no exit is added by the probe
criteria.N6_controls: re-read the written group (22 registered reads) and the unwritten group (66 never-written phrasings) in the same run with the same metrics, so every contrast is against a measured positive control, not against a remembered number
criteria.verdict_rule: any class with < 16 items -> not_assessable_construction_short; any class with share(top_cos >= 0.95) >= 0.8 and median(margin) < 0.05 -> always_answers_no_abstention; else if median(written.top_cos) - median(new_token.top_cos) >= 0.10 and share(new_token.top_cos < min(written.top_cos)) >= 0.8 and median(new_token.margin) >= 0.02 -> has_abstention_signal; otherwise -> inconclusive
criteria.threshold_source: the abstention threshold is the written group's minimum top cosine, taken from the positive control only; it is not fitted to the negative labels and no threshold is moved after the first reading
criteria.no_soft_language: a high cosine on a query with no answer is not called a good match; it is reported as a nearest-neighbour floor, and the forced-answer payload is reported next to it
criteria.unchanged: no threshold, fixture, face, position or class is retuned after the first reading

read_path_audit.empty_store_note: the only non-answer branch is occupied == 0, which reports the empty store; it does not decide that a query has no match
read_path_audit.write_gate_is_not_a_read_gate: growth_gate.evaluate refuses writes; it is never consulted on a read
